# PostGamma

> PostGamma embeds PostgreSQL 19 directly inside a Python or native application process. It starts no database server process and opens no network socket.

The first public release provides a CPython wheel and a static C SDK with bundled pgvector 0.8.6. A persistent database path is a PostgreSQL cluster directory, not a single file. A missing final cluster directory is created by default when its parent exists. Enable vector SQL objects per logical database with CREATE EXTENSION vector.

## Start here

- [Python quickstart](getting-started/): Create, query, close, and reopen a persistent cluster.
- [When to use PostGamma](getting-started/why-postgamma/): Compare the application boundary with SQLite, DuckDB, PGlite, and a PostgreSQL server.
- [Static C quickstart](getting-started/c-static/): Link the static SDK and run its validated native example.
- [Installation](getting-started/installation/): Choose a wheel or static C SDK.
- [Downloads](downloads/): Release status, binary forms, checksums, and source builds.
- [Database paths and creation](getting-started/database-paths/): Exact path, open-mode, logical database, and recovery rules.

## Python guides

- [Python overview](python/): Choose top-level connect, a managed Database, or asyncio.
- [Database and DB-API](python/database-and-dbapi/): Execute SQL, bind parameters, fetch results, and use cursors.
- [Asyncio](python/asyncio/): Drive native waitables from an event loop.
- [Streaming and COPY](python/streaming-and-copy/): Process bounded large transfers.
- [Management and logical backup](python/management/): Checkpoint, maintain, dump, and restore.
- [Events, codecs, and Arrow](python/integration/): Integrate diagnostics and data formats.
- [Python type mapping](python/types/): Map PostgreSQL OIDs to Python values without guessing.

## C SDK guides

- [C SDK overview](c/): Learn the handle hierarchy and seven-operation core.
- [Build, link, and deploy](c/build-and-link/): Consume libpostgamma.a and its resource pack.
- [Ownership and concurrency](c/ownership-and-concurrency/): Handle lifetime and thread-safety rules.
- [Asynchronous execution](c/async/): Progress requests without blocking the host loop.
- [Streaming and COPY](c/streaming-and-copy/): Use bounded row and COPY state machines.
- [Management and logical backup](c/management/): Drive instance operations.

## Concepts and compatibility

- [Architecture](concepts/architecture/): Understand the in-process boundary.
- [Connections and concurrency](concepts/concurrency/): Sessions, workers, pinning, threads, and fork.
- [Transactions](concepts/transactions/): Autocommit, context managers, rollback, and capacity.
- [Durability and recovery](concepts/durability/): Understand commit, crash recovery, checkpoints, and maintenance defaults.
- [Resource footprint](concepts/resource-footprint/): Size startup, memory, threads, and result buffers.
- [Security model](concepts/security/): Understand trusted inputs, SQL authority, extensions, and process scope.
- [PostgreSQL compatibility](compatibility/postgresql/): Preserved behavior and major-version rules.
- [Platforms and glibc](compatibility/platforms/): Binary and static-archive portability.
- [Limits](compatibility/limits/): Resource defaults and unsupported capabilities.
- [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting/): Diagnose package, path, SQL, concurrency, and link failures.
